author: Sebastian Witt
name: face_recognition
description: Exports images and runs facial recognition against a folder of known faces to automatically tag people in photos.
description-extensive: This tool automatically finds and labels people in your photos by comparing faces to a folder of reference pictures you provide, where each reference image is named after the person. When it recognizes someone, it adds their name as a tag to the photo. It needs the free 'face_recognition' software (by Adam Geitgey) installed on your computer to do the matching.
